Shipping

All orders are dispatched within 24 hours. Delivery then takes 2–5 days to metro cities and 3–7 days to other areas. We use express shipping at no extra cost, and shipping is free on prepaid orders.

Returns

We accept returns only if the product is damaged, defective or incorrect on delivery. It must be unused, in its original packaging, and reported within 48 hours of delivery. Full policy
